column1: # Georgian (ka) catalog. Same format as zh-hant.tsv:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
# (empty context = a plain UI string; `@id` = a command id; `@plural` = "one|other" forms).
# Clean-room: every entry is written from the meaning of VectorCraft's English label, following
# the shared Georgian glossary of the Craft apps (commands as verbal nouns: შენახვა, გახსნა; no
# capitals, Georgian has none); no other application's Georgian localisation was consulted or
# copied. Drafted with AI assistance (Claude); not yet reviewed by a native speaker.
# Vocabulary: სამუშაო დაფა (artboard), ტრაექტორია (path), საყრდენი წერტილი (anchor point),
# სახელური (handle), კონტური (stroke), შევსება (fill), გრადიენტი (gradient), ფერის ნიმუში
# შერევის რეჟიმი (blending mode), პრესეტი (preset), გაშლა (expand), მოხსნა
# Plurals: Georgian nouns stay singular after a number, so every @plural row has one form.
# Left in English on purpose (`MENU_KEEP_AS_IS` in the tests): the product name, language names,
# OpenType, the built-in workspace names and the bracketed perspective grid preset names. Keep
# placeholders, ellipses and the leading/trailing spaces of fragments when editing.
